description: Trigger evals for dv:director-mode (the home session in the main checkout directs worktree sessions: names newly unblocked tickets, recommends which worktrees to start and which can run in parallel, takes closeout notes, merges after MergeWren passes, keeps ticket states true; `off` ends it). Hard near-misses in no_trigger: running one ticket's work with hired engineers is dv:manager-mode; closing out a worktree is dv:closeout; merging one PR, creating a worktree, grooming or filing a ticket, and a handoff are ordinary work or their own skills. See tooling/evals/README.md.

queries.q: Switch to director mode: this is the home session and the worktrees run manager mode.
Be the director for this repo. Tell me which worktree sessions to start next and which can run in parallel.
Director mode off, I'll handle things myself.
You're the home session now: take the closeout notes, merge what passed MergeWren, and keep the tickets' states right.
Turn on director mode and coordinate the worktree sessions for this project.
Run the main checkout as the engineering director while each ticket's worktree hires its own engineers.
Director mode.
Act as the director over the worktree managers: advise what to start and do the merges.
Stop being the director and go back to normal work.
Load the director mode text; this session is the main checkout and should coordinate the others.
Switch to manager mode and hire engineers for this ticket.
Close out this worktree and brief the parent session.
Merge PR 42 now that the checks are green.
Create a new worktree for the billing fix.
Groom VIL-210 before anyone starts it.
Write a handoff for this session.
File a ticket for the flaky login test.
Pick up where we left off.
Delete the merged branch locally and on origin.
Write a status report for my director about this sprint.
